card.name: Space before treatment-duration day ranges
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space just before a number range of days (such as 7 to 21 days) in dosing tables, and also partway through words like capillary and platelet before pulmonary or aggregation terms.

modes.label: Space before day range
modes.description: A space token right before a duration such as 7 to 21 days after 'for' or in a duration column.

modes.label: Inside pulmonary/platelet terms
modes.description: Partway through words like capillary or platelet, or the word 'in' after 'reduction', in cardiovascular and clotting text.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward 'wedge' or 'margin' type words, which fits 'capillary wedge pressure'.
card.plain: It marks the gap before a treatment length like 7 to 14 days, and some spots inside lung-pressure and platelet words.
